reconstructed_values.hidden_geometry: All front-equipment pivots and hydraulic anchors, bucket four-bar geometry, swing bearing, undercarriage rollers and belt route, hose paths, motion curves and internal construction are reconstructed visualization choices.
reconstructed_values.visible_actuation_study: Two boom-lift cylinder assemblies, the arm-crowd assembly, bucket-curl assembly, pivoted H-link, paired dogbones, pins, clevises and bucket ears are independently reconstructed. Fixed and moving cylinder halves are parented to their owning structures, overlap in the neutral pose, and are sampled against published strokes; anchors remain reconstructed.
reconstructed_values.finite_pose_solver: A deterministic planar visualization solver samples the declared boom, arm, bucket and swing presentation limits for stroke feasibility, bucket four-bar closure, ground clearance and non-adjacent track clearance. It is not a dynamics, load, safety or manufacturer-authoritative solver.
